title: Finite etale extension across a regular codimension-two boundary
statement: Let $L$ be a locally Noetherian scheme, and $V\subseteq L$ an open subset. Suppose that for every $z\notin V$, the local ring $\mathcal O_{L,z}$ is regular [def-weil-regular-scheme] and has Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] at least two. For every finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] morphism $q:Y\to V$, there is a finite etale morphism $p:E\to L$ and an isomorphism $e:Y\cong E\times_L V$ over $V$; explicitly, $e\circ p|_V=q$. No global quasi-compactness or quasi-separatedness is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0BMA (pione-lemma-purity-regular); Tag 0EY7 (pione-lemma-purity-essentially-surjective); Tag 0H2W (final paragraph of the locally Noetherian extension theorem); Tag 0EY6(2), uniqueness by the depth-two extension identity

proof.text: For each missing stalk choose a minimal generating finite set of the maximal ideal. Regularity identifies its cardinality with Krull dimension. Its list is a regular system of parameters, hence a regular sequence by isRegular_and_quotients_of_generators. The definition of depth as a supremum bounds depth below by this length; the dimension hypothesis gives length at least two. This is the proved private depth_two_of_regular_local helper.

Apply exists_finite_extension_of_depth_two to V, the preceding depth bound and q. Obtain a finite p:E -> L with source depth at least two above the missing set, and an isomorphism e:E restricted to V -> Y over V. The equation e.hom followed by q = p restricted to V and etaleness of q imply etaleness of the restriction.

Prove stalk flatness of p. For z above V, the restricted etale morphism has flat stalk map, and morphismRestrictStalkMap transports it along the open-immersion stalk isomorphisms. For z not above V, use flat_stalk_of_regular_codimension_two_depth_two_extension. Mathlib Flat.of_stalkMap then gives Flat p.

Apply formallyUnramified_of_flat_depth_two_finite_extension to obtain FormallyUnramified p. Finiteness over locally Noetherian L supplies local finite presentation, so Etale.of_formallyUnramified_of_flat gives Etale p. Return E, p and the inverse e.symm; compose the original equation with e.inv and simplify the inverse identities to obtain e.symm.hom followed by p restricted to V = q.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0EY6(1),(2),(3) for construction and etaleness assembly, Tag 00NQ for the regular-local depth bound, and Tags 0BMA and 0EY7 for the remaining supplied-extension flatness statement

lean.statement: theorem exists_finite_etale_extension_of_regular_codimension_two_boundary {L Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian L] (V : L.Opens) (hboundary : ∀ z : L, z ∉ V → IsRegularLocalRing (L.presheaf.stalk z) ∧ (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim (L.presheaf.stalk z)) (q : Y ⟶ V.toScheme) [IsFinite q] [Etale q] : ∃ (E : Scheme.{u}) (p : E ⟶ L), IsFinite p ∧ Etale p ∧ ∃ e : Y ≅ (p ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme, e.hom ≫ (p ∣_ V) = q
